glossentry.glossdef:
Describes any component that represents an external device. It has several device extensions, one being the Config Device Ext. By default, this extension contains a (frozen) device object component, which represents the single BACnet device object in that device. You cannot delete this component. You can add and delete other Config objects as needed.
On the server side, the configuration of a station’s single Local Device component under its BacnetNetwork represents the station’s device object.
